Second, every example runs exactly as written. Third, every function from another package is declared, so the check finds nothing undefined.

visual.title: Two functions, one clean package
items: Exports and docs from roxygen comments

text: Each exported function documents every parameter and its return value. The examples section uses small inline data, so it runs on any machine. The export tag puts clean site in the namespace. Helpers without it stay internal. The body is the rule from the first challenge: trim, upper-case, and insert the hyphen, with missing values left missing.
caption: Each exported function documents every parameter and its return value. The @examples section uses small inline data, so it runs on any machine. The @export tag puts clean_site() in the NAMESPACE. Helpers without it stay internal. The body is the rule from the first challenge: trim, upper-case, and insert the hyphen, with NA left as NA.

text: Summarise arm follows the same pattern: parameters, return value, and an example. The import lines are what most attempts miss. Group by and summarise come from dee plier, and S D comes from stats, not base R. The body returns one row per arm, and passes the missing-value setting straight through to mean and S D.
caption: summarise_arm() follows the same pattern: parameters, return value, and an example. The @importFrom lines are what most attempts miss. group_by() and summarise() come from dplyr, and sd() comes from stats, not base R. The body returns one row per arm, and passes na_rm straight through to mean() and sd().

text: Three mistakes account for most failed attempts. Calling S D, or group by, without importing them leaves undefined globals, and the globals check fails. An example that reads a file the reader doesn't have will not run, and the examples check fails. And a missing param or return tag leaves the help page incomplete, which fails the docs check.
caption: Three mistakes account for most failed attempts. Calling group_by() or sd() without importing them leaves undefined globals, and the globals check fails. An example that reads a file the reader doesn't have will not run, and the examples check fails. And a missing @param or @return tag leaves the help page incomplete, which fails the docs check.

items.mistake: An example that reads a missing file
